policy: Ideas may come from external/web research, but raster 3 may only consume an idea after its strategy family is implemented and the Germany/Saarland research-policy gate allows the modeled market. Blind-window information is never written here.

ideas.hypothesis: Compare breakout and mean-reversion families conditionally by pre-window volatility/trend regime instead of judging either family globally.
ideas.source_title: Bollinger Bands under Varying Market Regimes: A Comparative Study of Breakout and Mean-Reversion Strategies in BTC/USDT
ideas.research_note: Use only as a hypothesis source. The paper reports regime-dependent behavior; our own blind windows must decide whether it generalizes to this bot and fee model.

ideas.hypothesis: Treat short-vs-long realized volatility structure plus normalized direction as a control layer for choosing strategy family.
ideas.source_title: Detecting Volatility Regimes in Crypto Markets using Realized Volatility Structure and Normalized Momentum
ideas.research_note: Current EvidenceRegimeAgent uses return, volatility and trend gap; test whether a volatility-expansion family performs better specifically in expansion regimes.

ideas.hypothesis: Test short-horizon reversal only in regimes where expected gross edge can plausibly exceed the configured round-trip costs; do not assume unconditional profitability.
ideas.source_title: Short-horizon mean reversion in cryptocurrency markets: a matched cross-market measurement
ideas.research_note: The paper reports pervasive 15-minute directional reversal but also reports gross edge below its benchmark spot round-trip cost, so transaction-cost survival is a mandatory gate.
